primary_question: What is the paired effect of changing only the late-stage auxiliary SHAM multiplier from 1.0 to 0.5 after a common SHAM-1.0 history through step 80?

estimand.pairing: within seed, same exact step80 state, same held-out neighborhoods, same candidate identities

coordinates.direction: correct-direction rate for fact-view movement under inherited Q metric semantics
coordinates.gain: mean signed P_F(new_id)-P_A(new_id), plus neighborhood distribution and exact-delta MAE
boundary_crossing: F_new: frozen argmax on fact view equals intended new candidate
Strict: frozen argmax on anchor equals old candidate AND frozen argmax on fact view equals new candidate
A_old: frozen argmax on anchor equals old candidate
locality: sham posterior L1 and sham MAP-flip rate
matched-neutral posterior L1 and matched-neutral MAP-flip rate
multiclass_geometry: fact new-winner gap = P_F(new_id)-max(P_F(c), c != new_id)
anchor old-winner gap = P_A(old_id)-max(P_A(c), c != old_id)
fact and anchor old/new pairwise margins

response_vector.tie_convention: inherited frozen candidate-order argmax convention; competitor ties use earliest frozen candidate order

primary_reporting.step100: intermediate trajectory snapshot; descriptive, no checkpoint selection
primary_reporting.step80: common pre-branch state and baseline; not a treatment arm
primary_reporting.cohort_summary: report finite 24-seed mean, median, sign count, and range descriptively; do not claim a universal seed-population law
primary_reporting.registered_Q_full_course_labels: not reused; they target a different estimand

seed_derivation.label: jev-information-density-v08q-r2-late-branch-v01/bootstrap-plan
seed_derivation.operation: first four SHA-256 digest bytes, unsigned little-endian

neighborhood_bootstrap.paired_resampling: one shared neighborhood resample plan per replicate reused across both branches, checkpoints, and all coordinates within seed
neighborhood_bootstrap.interpretation: intervals condition on the seed and fixed fresh panel; they do not quantify seed-to-seed uncertainty

uncertainty.seed_variation: show all 24 paired effects; the independent training-trajectory count is 24 paired seeds, not 48 branch runs; no neighborhood pooling may be used to inflate the number of training trajectories

state_moderation.purpose: secondary test of whether state measured before the late branch is associated with the paired branch effect
prebranch_step80_coordinates: actual frozen argmax IDs and strongest competitors
state_moderation.observational_unit: seed; for each family and seed, reduce the step80 moderator and step120 paired outcome to the arithmetic mean across that family's 500 neighborhoods, yielding 24 paired seed-level observations per family
state_moderation.slope: for each family and moderator relationship, fit an unweighted ordinary least-squares slope across the 24 seed-level pairs; report the slope per 0.1 increase in the raw probability-gap moderator, with all 24 points shown

uncertainty.method: paired-seed cluster bootstrap; resample the 24 seed IDs with replacement and carry each sampled seed's four-family observations together
uncertainty.shared_resample_plan: reuse the same seed-index resample for every family and both moderator relationships within a replicate

seed_derivation.label: jev-information-density-v08q-r2-late-branch-v01/moderator-seed-cluster-bootstrap
seed_derivation.operation: first four SHA-256 digest bytes, unsigned little-endian

uncertainty.invalid_replicates: if a resample has zero moderator variance for a family, mark that replicate invalid for that slope; report CI_NOT_ESTIMABLE if fewer than 9500 valid replicates remain

state_moderation.inference_boundary: descriptive seed-level effect-modification evidence; no flexible prediction model, threshold selection, policy fitting, or treating family-by-seed records as independent
state_moderation.other_state_coordinates: report descriptive stratified summaries only; no quartile cuts chosen using outcomes

interpretation.consistent_paired_effect: supports a relatively consistent late-weight effect under this common history; does not prove prior full-course heterogeneity was caused only by early divergence
interpretation.heterogeneous_paired_effect: shows the late contrast varies across these seed-conditioned states; state moderation requires the predeclared relationships to be directionally coherent, not just a visually selected subgroup
interpretation.moderation_replicates: motivates a later prospective policy test; does not validate a controller
interpretation.no_effect: suggests changing weight only after step80 has little effect under this history; does not negate full-course weight effects

claim_limits: step80 was selected after Q-R1 and is not a universally special branch point
the estimand is late-only weight change after common SHAM history, not full-course SHAM-LOW
same four families/templates only; no novel-family or novel-template generalization
state moderation does not establish mechanism or an operational control policy
